newsitem.title: USA: ADVISORY - Chicago exchanges' holiday hours.
newsitem.headline: ADVISORY - Chicago exchanges' holiday hours.

text.p: Chicago's futures and options exchanges said they would observe the following schedules for the Veterans Day holiday on Monday, November 11:

At the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME), all contracts close at noon on November 11 except Goldman Sachs Commodity Index and equity index products, which will trade their normal hours. GLOBEX trading will open at 1730 CST/2330 GMT.
CME contracts will trade normal hours Friday, November 8.
On Friday, Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) financial and insurance contracts closed early at 1210 CST/1810 GMT but agricultural and metals contracts will trade normal hours.
CBOT's financial and insurance futures and options, including U.S. Treasury bond futures, will be shut on Monday.
The CBOT said it revised its trading hours for the products, which originally were slated to be open on Monday.
All other CBOT contracts, including agricultural, will observe normal trading hours on Monday.
Project A afternoon session will be shut on Monday, but evening pit trading and the overnight Project A session will be open, the CBOT said.
On Sunday, November 10, CBOT evening pit trading will be closed.
Overnight Project A session will be open for agricultural products but closed for financial products.
At the Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE), trading will observe normal hours on Monday except for interest-rate options, which will be closed.
On Friday, CBOE contracts will trade normal hours except interest-rate options, which will finish at 1200 CST/1800 GMT. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750 E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
